name: nijashwa-studio
description: Nijashwa Studio - a free, offline-first video editor (single-file HTML/JS) packaged as an Android app with Capacitor.

scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
